business_problem: Turba Media needed to analyze growing volumes of GDPR-compliant audience data from social and content platforms faster so it could uncover sentiment shifts, identify emerging trends and improve media-buying decisions for clients.
solution_summary: Turba Media worked with IBM to embed generative AI into its audience-intelligence workflow using IBM watsonx.ai. The agency already collected large volumes of data through proprietary, GDPR-compliant APIs connected to major social media platforms and blog networks, but it needed a way to turn that data into actionable insights at a much higher speed. Using watsonx.ai, Turba Media combined traditional machine learning with generative AI to segment audiences, analyze sentiment, forecast trends and generate advanced reports based on custom campaign metrics. The platform feeds marketers with richer insight about behavior and culture signals so they can refine media buying, optimize ad placement and package results for clients more quickly.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Applies machine learning and generative AI to audience data so Turba Media can segment users, analyze sentiment and generate campaign insights.

data_flow: GDPR-compliant proprietary APIs ingest audience and content signals from social platforms and blog networks into Turba Media’s analytics environment, where IBM watsonx.ai analyzes behavior, sentiment and trends and then generates reports and recommendations for campaign teams.
business_outcome: Turba Media accelerated insight generation for clients and used the results to improve campaign targeting, media-buying decisions and return on ad spend.
architecture_clues: Analyzes data collected through proprietary GDPR-compliant APIs
Uses real-time sentiment analysis and trend forecasting
Insights are fed into media-buying and ad-placement decisions
evidence_quotes: Facing growing pressure to provide deeper, more instantaneous analytics, Turba Media aimed to incorporate generative AI (gen AI) into their analytics infrastructure.
They chose IBM® watsonx.ai®, an enterprise-grade AI studio, because of its ability to bring together traditional machine learning (ML) and gen AI capabilities.
The metrics include <4.62% click-through rate (CTR) and a 5.56+ return on ad spend (ROAS).
